title: Outcome Summary Record
body:
Overview

This is Manon's original Signature counterpart for Outcome Summary Record inside the Operational Lessons and After-Action Signature Database, built as part of the Signature ecosystem rather than copied from any outside source. Turns documented outcomes into traceable improvements, procedures and training scenarios. The Signature edition keeps the same discipline as the public edition: every entry states the task, shows the method in full, and carries a demo program that was genuinely executed at build time, so the result shown is a result that actually ran. Signature records are labeled as Signature originals wherever they appear, and they never present a design as an established fact. A design is called a design, a measured result is called a measured result, and the difference is kept visible in the record itself.

How it works

The method in each record turns an outcome into an improvement with a traceable chain: what happened, what was learned, what action was assigned, and how the improvement was verified. A lesson counts as closed only when its action is done and its verification is recorded; otherwise it stays open and visible.

The worked detail for this Signature entry is concrete and reproducible. The accompanying demo program ran at build time and its output begins with: actions: 5. The complete program and its full output travel with this record, so any reader can re-run the code and confirm the result independently. The Signature version adapts the public method to Signature conventions: the same checks, the same honesty about limits, and the same requirement that a claim travel no further than its evidence. Where this entry describes a procedure, the steps are ordered and checkable; where it describes a model, the inputs, the calculation, and the uncertainty are all stated; where it describes a plan, the constraints are named first, because a plan that hides its constraints cannot be trusted when conditions change.

Use and ladder

A team uses these records so the same lesson is learned once and kept: procedures get revised, training scenarios get built from real outcomes, and repeat findings are caught by the tracker. # Outcome Summary Record: track lesson actions to closure with verification.
actions = [('revise procedure', True), ('build training scenario', True), ('update checklist', True), ('verify improvement', False), ('share lesson', True)]

open_items = [name for name, ok in actions if not ok]
print("actions:", len(actions))
print("closed:", len(done), done)

print("closure fraction:", round(len(done) / len(actions), 3))
print("lesson closed:", not open_items)
